items.exampleEn: His joke rendered the whole room silent.
items.exampleZh: 他的笑話讓全場都安靜了下來。

items.exampleEn: The farmer isolated the sick sheep from the other animals.
items.exampleZh: 農夫把生病的羊和其他動物隔離開來。

items.exampleEn: The book comprises twelve short stories.
items.exampleZh: 這本書收錄了十二篇短篇小說。

items.exampleEn: I felt compelled to say something when I saw him cheating.
items.exampleZh: 看到他作弊，我覺得不得不說點什麼。

items.exampleEn: She felt isolated during her first weeks at the new school.
items.exampleZh: 剛到新學校的頭幾個星期，她覺得很孤單。

items.exampleEn: House prices plunged after the factory closed.
items.exampleZh: 工廠關閉之後，房價暴跌。

items.exampleEn: After the restoration of electricity, the shops opened again.
items.exampleZh: 電力恢復之後，商店又重新營業了。

items.exampleEn: Clutching her ticket, she ran to the gate.
items.exampleZh: 她緊緊抓著票，跑向登機門。

items.sentenceEn: The team comprises six engineers and two designers.
items.sentenceZh: 這個團隊由六名工程師和兩名設計師組成。

items.audioEn: The old theater opened again last week after two years of careful restoration.
items.audioZh: 那間老戲院經過兩年細心的修復，上週重新開幕了。
items.questionZh: 這間老戲院發生了什麼事？
options: It closed for good last year.
It was sold to a hotel.
It moved to a new street.

items.sentenceEn: Temperatures plunged to minus five degrees last night.
items.sentenceZh: 昨晚氣溫驟降到零下五度。

items.sentenceEn: The little girl clutched her mother's hand in the crowd.
items.sentenceZh: 那個小女孩在人群中緊緊抓著媽媽的手。

items.stemEn: The ____ of the old bridge took three years and cost a lot of money.
items.stemZh: 這座舊橋的修復工程花了三年，也花了很多錢。

items.stemEn: The village is so ____ that the nearest shop is an hour away by car.
items.stemZh: 這個村子非常偏僻，最近的商店開車要一個小時。

items.passageEn: Last winter, heavy snow brought down trees around an isolated mountain village. The fallen trees blocked the only road, rendering it impossible for cars to reach the village for a week. The village comprises about forty houses, most of them very old. The situation compelled the local government to act. From the outset, workers cleared the road day and night, and volunteers carried food up the mountain on foot. When the road finally opened again, the villagers held a small celebration. Now a plan for the restoration of the old houses is being discussed, and a second road is planned so that the village will never again be isolated for so long.
items.passageZh: 去年冬天，一場大雪壓倒了一座偏僻山村周圍的樹木。倒下的樹擋住了唯一的道路，使汽車有一個星期無法開進村裡。這個村子大約有四十戶房子，大多非常老舊。這個情況迫使地方政府採取行動。工人從一開始就日夜清理道路，志工則徒步把食物揹上山。道路終於重新開通時，村民辦了一場小小的慶祝會。現在大家正在討論修復老房子的計畫，也規劃了第二條道路，讓村子再也不會和外界隔絕這麼久。

questions.questionZh: 那一週汽車為什麼無法進村？
options: 道路正在進行拓寬工程
村民不讓外地車輛進入

questions.questionZh: 現在大家在討論什麼計畫？
options: 修復村子裡那些老房子

items.promptZh: 這次停電讓我的電腦完全無法使用。
referenceEn: The power cut rendered my computer completely useless.
The power failure has rendered my computer useless.
rubricZh: render＋受詞＋形容詞表示「使變得⋯」（例如 rendered my computer useless 等）
「停電」可寫，例如 power cut、power failure 等
時態配合內容（例如 rendered、has rendered 等）

items.instructionZh: 用 clutch 當動詞造一個句子，描述你緊緊抓著某樣東西的情景。
referenceEn: I clutched my bag tightly on the crowded train.
I clutched the rail when the boat started to shake.
rubricZh: clutch 當動詞表示「緊抓」（例如 clutched my bag 等）
時態配合內容（例如 clutched、clutch 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：干擾項 amplification（本範圍 mcq 出現 6 次）、characterization（4 次）、manipulation 為冷僻長字名詞且多課重複，與「舊橋」語意完全無關，一眼可排除。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: q13 干擾項改為先前課（u02）教過的名詞 antiquity、cessation、succession，代入「舊橋的⋯花了三年」皆不通

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：q14 混合詞性題三個干擾項都放不進形容詞空格
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 crowded、modern（形容詞，放得進空格但與「最近商店一小時車程」矛盾）與 compel

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（執行長釋義原則）：isolate 例句「Living alone in the mountains isolated him from his old friends.」示範的是次要義，第一義應為最常用義「使隔離」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 例句改寫為「The farmer isolated the sick sheep from the other animals.」示範第一義；釋義為「使隔離；使孤立」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（執行長釋義原則）：plunge 例句「She took a quick plunge into the cold lake.」示範的是次要義，第一義應為最常用義「驟降」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 例句改寫為「House prices plunged after the factory closed.」示範第一義；釋義為「驟降；跳入、投入」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（執行長釋義原則）：clutch 例句「Press the clutch before you change gears.」示範的是次要義，第一義應為最常用義「緊抓」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 例句改寫為「Clutching her ticket, she ran to the gate.」示範第一義；釋義為「緊抓；（汽車的）離合器」
